answer_1.quote: Mathematical question generation ... is a significant research direction ... we propose EQPR to generate high-quality mathematical questions ...
answer_1.outputs: generated mathematical questions aligned with educational objectives

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we primarily employ three metrics from the EQGEVAL framework ... we also incorporate ... Rouge-L, BLEU, METEOR, and BERTScore.

answer_3.quote: We employed DeepSeek-V3 to solve the generated questions ... determine solvability ... Pass Rate ... Win Rate ... we present pairs of questions to DeepSeek-V3 evaluators ... to decide which is superior.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 100 samples ... enlisted three highly educated evaluators ... The evaluation focused on two key dimensions: question clarity ... and quality comparison.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assess question clarity (readability, understandability) and compare quality against gold-standard questions.
